verdict.rationale: The SOS business page links an "Intelligence Center - Business data" and data requests. The Colorado open-data portal publishes business entity, DBA and UCC filing information, and a probe confirmed a keyless JSON endpoint for the business-entities dataset that needs no scraping. Bulk delivery runs through the Socrata-hosted state portal rather than the registry itself, and download/export of the business datasets is shown only by the API probe and a generic download claim for spatial datasets. missing for 10: explicit first-party docs for full bulk downloads or registry extracts of business data (CSV or file exports, update cadence, field documentation), evidence of wage or case statistics, and independent corroboration beyond a single probe GET.

support.subject: As a developer, the service publishes bulk public-data downloads or extracts (datasets, registry extracts, wage or case statistics) that need no scraping
